name: douyin-series
doc: short-drama series episode list (capability G SeriesChain / proposals H, P2): same completeness/follow-update face as the mix chain on the series id. Evidence: corpus GET /aweme/v1/web/series/aweme/?series_id=...&pull_type=0&cursor=...&count=... (f2 pull_type: int, initially 0) -> {aweme_list[full detail aweme], extra, has_more, log_pb, max_cursor, min_cursor, related_item_tag:-1, selection_panel_conf, status_code:0, status_msg, watch_histories:null} — a max_cursor chain (NOT the mix's plain index cursor) and NO item_id_to_episode map, so episode numbers derive from walk order (page position); oracle probe: full chain 6 pages 33 episodes, cursor closure, unique ids, repeat-walk deterministic. The series_id is discovered passively from detail/search cards' series_info.series_id (probe: 5/20 search cards carry it).
